product_overview: TestSprite is an automated full-stack project inspection and testing platform that analyzes frontend, backend, database and security posture, runs functional and security tests, and generates actionable reports. It exposes REST APIs to trigger inspections, run test suites, and retrieve results for integration with developer workflows and CI/CD.
core_goals: Automatically inspect and review a codebase (frontend, backend, DB, security) and produce a prioritized report of issues.
Run automated test suites (unit, integration, API, security) against the project and return deterministic results and artifacts.
Provide REST API endpoints to upload or point to a repository, trigger scans/tests, and fetch reports for CI/CD integration.
Surface critical security, performance, and production-readiness blockers with actionable remediation steps.
Support reproducible test runs and archival of results for auditing and tracking progress.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: User registration and login to access protected TestSprite features and retrieve personalized scan results.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/signup with {email, password, name} -> Receive 201 with created user id
POST /api/auth/login with {email, password} -> Receive 200 with JWT token
POST /api/auth/signup with missing password -> Receive 400 with validation error
POST /api/auth/login with incorrect password -> Receive 401 with authentication error

features.name: Listings (Public Project Catalog)
features.description: Public endpoint to retrieve example or previously-run scan listings (e.g., recent projects, scan summaries). No authentication required for read-only access.
user_flows: GET /api/listings -> Receive 200 with listings array (each item: project_id, name, last_scan_at, status)
GET /api/listings?limit=10&offset=0 -> Receive 200 with paginated listings
GET /api/listings?limit=-1 -> Receive 400 with validation error for invalid query parameter
GET /api/listings when database is unreachable -> Receive 500 with server error

features.name: Project Inspection / Static Review
features.description: Upload or point at a repository for a full static inspection (frontend, backend, DB schema analysis, dependency checks). Produces a detailed report listing issues, severity, and remediation suggestions.
user_flows: POST /api/inspect/upload with {repo_url, branch, config} -> Receive 202 with scan_id
POST /api/inspect/start with {scan_id} -> Receive 202 scan started
GET /api/inspect/status/{scan_id} with valid token -> Receive 200 with status: queued|running|completed
GET /api/inspect/results/{scan_id} with valid token when completed -> Receive 200 with JSON report including executive_summary, issues[]
POST /api/inspect/upload with invalid repo_url -> Receive 400 with validation error
GET /api/inspect/results/{unknown_scan_id} -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Automated Test Runner
features.description: Run curated test suites (API endpoint tests, integration flows, security tests) against the target project and return structured results and artifacts (logs, failure traces).
user_flows: POST /api/tests/run with {scan_id, suites:[api,security,performance], env} and valid token -> Receive 202 with test_run_id
GET /api/tests/status/{test_run_id} with valid token -> Receive 200 with status: running|failed|passed
GET /api/tests/results/{test_run_id} with valid token when finished -> Receive 200 with results summary and links to artifacts
POST /api/tests/run without required suites field -> Receive 400 with validation error
GET /api/tests/results/{test_run_id} when runner experienced internal error -> Receive 500 with error details

features.name: Security Scanning (Dynamic & SAST)
features.description: Run static analysis and dynamic security tests (XSS, SQLi, JWT handling, file upload checks). Returns vulnerability findings with severity and remediation guidance.
user_flows: POST /api/security/scan with {target_url, scan_types:[sast,dast], credentials} and valid token -> Receive 202 with security_scan_id
GET /api/security/scan/{security_scan_id}/status -> Receive 200 with status: queued|running|completed
GET /api/security/scan/{security_scan_id}/report -> Receive 200 with vulnerabilities array (id, type, severity, details, remediation)
POST /api/security/scan with missing target_url -> Receive 400 with validation error
GET /api/security/scan/{security_scan_id}/report when scanner crashed -> Receive 500 with scanner error

features.name: Report Retrieval & Export
features.description: Fetch generated reports, download as PDF/JSON, and retrieve historical results for audit and tracking.
user_flows: GET /api/reports/{report_id} with valid token -> Receive 200 with report JSON
GET /api/reports/{report_id}/export?format=pdf with valid token -> Receive 200 with PDF binary (Content-Type: application/pdf)
GET /api/reports/{report_id} with expired token -> Receive 401 unauthorized
GET /api/reports/{missing_report_id} -> Receive 404 not found
